bio: A modern floral sign serves as the restaurant's symbol as its name refers to the rose of Sharon, the national flower of South Korea. The chef vows to pay respect to his home country and contribute to the development of Korean cuisine. He relies on a palate nurtured by the flavours of his mother’s cooking. Unravelling the history of food culture, he utilises his experience in Western cuisine. Nori gimbap rolls are presented as rice crackers. Raw prawn ganjang saeu is served with a caviar and kiwifruit sauce. The chef presents new culinary expressions with a modern sensibility.
